Welcome, my name is Mia and I work at the confluence of water, land and society. I am currently in the Watershed Sciences graduate program at Colorado State University (CSU). Outside of work I like climbing rocks and sliding down snowy mountains on sticks. Fun facts: I am a certified yoga instructor and I have lived in New Zealand for a year.
